newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy lira at highest level vs mark since June '94.
newsitem.headline: Italy lira at highest level vs mark since June '94.

text.p: The Italian lira firmed to its highest level since the end of June 1994, trading up at 979.83 per mark in early European business.
The currency was quoted at 980.05/0.35 at 0735 GMT compared with 982 in late European trade on Monday, and has been helped by the firmer dollar.
The lira was readmitted to Europe's exchange rate mechanism just over a week ago at a central parity of 990.00 per mark.
It was quoted at 1,533.00/4.00 per dollar in early trade.
